capabilities: Save the current set of open tabs as a named context
Switch between saved contexts, closing current tabs and loading the saved set
Create contexts manually with a file picker and delete them from a management UI
Restore tab groups containing Markdown, PDF, Canvas, and image files
disambiguation: Not a task or project context manager; it saves and restores sets of open tabs.
extras: Distributed via BRAT (beta plugin tracker) or manual file installation; no community plugin store instructions are given. Layout arrangement is not preserved across devices, only the file paths of open tabs.
intentEvidence: avoids the workspace.json inconsistency issue in Core Workspaces
problem: Obsidian's core Workspaces stores layout in workspace.json, which can conflict when the same vault is synced across desktop and mobile.
summary: Tab-set manager that saves open tabs as named contexts and switches between them, supporting all file types and staying sync-safe across devices.
